about.title: About WPPB
about.purpose: This project represents the community of Wikipedians in real life.
about.history: The first technical implementation was made by Ulli Purwin (interface) and Euku (bot). In early 2011, Ireas and Wiegels took over Ulli's part. The interface no longer runs on a private server but on Wikimedia Toolforge.
about.more_info: You can find more information about the Personal acquaintances project on the Wikipedia page Wikipedia:Persönliche Bekanntschaften (in German).
about.technology: This interface uses Python and MySQL. The source code is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License 3 (LGPL 3) and is available on GitHub. Bug reports, feature requests and other comments are welcome there or on the Wikipedia talk page.
about.dumps: Current database dumps are available here.

admin_login.title: Admin: Login
admin_login.intro: This is where the maintainers of the project Wikipedia:Persönliche Bekanntschaften look after the database. There is nothing to see here for anyone else: the participants and confirmations are public on the regular pages, and requests go through the project page on dewiki.
admin_login.feature_users: Edit users: Hide or exclude participants, change the (public) admin comment, compare name and user_id with dewiki.
admin_login.feature_confirmations: Manage confirmations: Mark confirmations as deleted, change their comment or delete them completely.
admin_login.feature_audit: Admin log: All changes made by admins and jobs, with reasons (not public).
admin_login.feature_vanished: Vanished accounts: Hide accounts that were globally renamed at their own request, with the reason from the rename log on Meta.
admin_login.feature_checks: Consistency checks: Find contradictions in the database and differences from dewiki.
admin_login.feature_jobs: Job status: Latest runs and errors of the Toolforge jobs.
admin_login.audit_note: Every change needs a reason and is recorded with name and time in the non-public admin log.
admin_login.contact: Please send questions and correction requests to the talk page of the project.
admin_login.logged_in: You are logged in as {name}: go to the overview.
admin_login.oauth_note: You log in with your Wikimedia account (OAuth on meta.wikimedia.org). The tool only learns your username and gets no rights on the wiki.
admin_login.not_configured: The login has not been set up yet (OAuth credentials are missing).
admin_login.error_expired: The login has expired or is invalid, please try again.
admin_login.error_failed: The login with Wikimedia failed, please try again later.
